authority_name: National Financial Regulatory Administration Financial Consumer Protection Center
channel_name: 12378 Banking and Insurance Consumer Complaint Hotline (12378银行保险消费者投诉维权热线)
jurisdiction_scope: Mainland China national banking and insurance disputes
procedure_summary: Policyholders who fail to resolve insurance claim or coverage disputes through direct insurer customer service may lodge an official regulatory complaint via hotline 12378.
published_deadlines: Insurer required to handle and respond within 15 calendar days of receiving supervisory referral
filing_guidance: Provide insurance policy number, insurer legal entity name, and claimant identification
Detail the claim denial or service grievance with factual supporting documents
State explicit resolution demands (e.g., policy claim payment, clarification of denial basis)
